mainImage.alt: Trump signing mass pardons as soon as he hits the oval office.
mainImage.caption: Former Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich during a press conference in Chicago. Blagojevich, convicted of corruption for trying to sell President Obama's vacated Senate seat, was pardoned by Trump and has become a pardon broker for wealthy clients.

body.alt: Donald Trump sits at the Resolute Desk in the Oval Office with a fountain pen in hand, signing executive orders. Several officials stand around him watching the signing ceremony in the historic Oval Office with its iconic windows.
body.caption: President Donald Trump signs executive orders in the Oval Office during his first day back in office in January 2025. Trump used the early hours of his presidency to pardon January 6 rioters and sign executive orders.

body.alt: A chaotic scene at the U.S. Capitol building on January 6, 2021, showing a large crowd of pro-Trump supporters breaching security barriers and climbing the Capitol steps under overcast skies.
body.caption: Pro-Trump supporters storm the U.S. Capitol building on January 6, 2021. Many January 6 rioters who were convicted of attacking the Capitol have received pardons from President Trump.
